content.descriptor: Three Korean skincare brands and professional aesthetic devices, brought together by AGAFAR Medical Beauty Group.
about: AGAFAR brings together dermatology clinics, skincare and professional aesthetic equipment. The group's clinic history dates to 2010. Its Korean clinic website lists six locations: Mia, Seongnam, Gwangmyeong, Gimpo, Gyeyang and Juan.

According to the company, AGAFAR Clinic and AGAFAR Medi Lounge have more than 40 branches across Korea and overseas, including Hong Kong, China, Thailand and Canada. Its skincare portfolio has three brands: AGAFAR, agapharma and a'reiv.

AGAFAR's materials identify two separate awards in dermatology and derma-cosmetics: first place in the 2023 KPBA awards and the 2026 KBEI award. The KBEI certificate is dated 3 April 2026 and names The JoongAng alongside the organizer.
facts: 20 products in the DERMA MODE PROGRAM catalog

lines.name: AGAFAR
lines.note: Gentle daily skincare for sensitive and problem-prone skin, from cleansing to sun protection. The line includes toner, ampoules, eye care and creams, with formulas built around peptides, PDRN, ceramides and botanical extracts.

lines.name: agapharma
lines.note: The professional Meditive Formula 3X line combines Hyal-Collagen, Bio Lacto Exosome and Super Centella. Its catalog covers a foam cleanser, ampoule, skin booster and two creams.

lines.name: a'reiv
lines.note: Two complementary formats: a Hyaluronic Ultra-Fine sheet mask and Calming Sun Cream SPF50+ PA++++.
